{{Top|leg}}
A '''sensor scrambler'''<ref name="GG5">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> or '''electronic scrambler'''<ref name="Elrood">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref> was a piece of equipment employed by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] commandos. The [[Endor strike team/Legends|Endor strike team]] carried these during their mission to destroy the [[Endor shield generator bunker]].<ref name="GG5" /> They could be used to scramble [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] readings from [[weapon detector]]s.<ref name="Elrood" />
